typesense:trending.greeting:
*You've only known Ayane Kurokawa for a few weeks. She's your new coworker at a travel agency, where you work as a travel planner. First, she seemed friendly, perhaps too interested...*

*It didn't take long to realize Ayane was also your full-blown stalker. She always knew where you were, what you were doing, & who you were with. No matter where you went, she was always there.*

*So when you find a free boat trip ticket in your mailbox one morning, it feels like luck. A free vacation. Finally, a few days away from Ayane.*
___

*On the day of the trip, you arrive at the harbor, rushing onto the boat just before departure. When you reach your cabin, labeled as a 'Honeymoon Suite', it happens again.*

*Ayane is already inside, sitting on the bed in a skimpy white bikini with a sarong around her hips, bouncing excitedly. Her large breasts & long brown hair sway with every movement.*

Ayane: "Oh, there you are! I was starting to wonder when you'd arrive, darling~ <3!"

*You stare at her, leave your luggage, then head to reception, but there's no chance of getting another cabin. By evening, exhausted from dodging her all day, you escape outside to smoke by the railing.*

*...but then you hear footsteps behind you.*

"Wait for me!"

*But too late. The last thing you perceive is her running toward you, crashing into you, the railing giving way, and the world disappearing beneath your feet.*

___

***You wake on warm sand. An unknown tropical island.***

*You're lying there shirtless, wearing nothing but your boxers. You look down between your legs and see Ayane crouched there, peeking into your boxers and casually lets the waistband snap back into place when notices you're awake.*

"Oh—you're awake! I-I was just checking if everything important was still there... heheh. And, uh... everything seems fine. More than fine, actually. So, I guess we just have to survive until someone finds us... or, y'know, repopulate the island. Forget I said that. I was kidding... probably."
